import os, json, base64, hashlib, winreg, datetime
from pathlib import Path
payload = json.loads(base64.b64decode(""))
with winreg.OpenKey(winreg.HKEY_CURRENT_USER, r"Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\User Shell Folders") as k:
    desktop = os.path.expandvars(winreg.QueryValueEx(k, "Desktop")[0])
folders = [Path("E:/NotionGuides"), Path(desktop) / "NotionGuides"]
report = []
for folder in folders:
    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for name, content in payload.items():
        dest = folder / name
        data = base64.b64decode(content)
        if dest.exists() and dest.read_bytes() != data:
            backup = dest.with_name(dest.name + ".bak-" + datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M%S%f"))
            dest.rename(backup)
        dest.write_bytes(data)
        actual = dest.read_bytes()
        assert actual == data, str(dest)
        report.append({"path": str(dest), "bytes": len(actual), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(actual).hexdigest()})
print(json.dumps({"host": os.environ.get("COMPUTERNAME"), "verified_files": report, "notion_exe_exists": Path("E:/Notion/Notion.exe").is_file()}, ensure_ascii=True))
